title_zh: 河北省委主要负责同志职务调整
title_en: Personnel Adjustment of Hebei Provincial Party Committee Leadership
summary_zh: 中共中央决定，罗文任河北省委书记；倪岳峰不再担任河北省委书记，另有任用。
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee has decided that Luo Wen will serve as Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, succeeding Ni Yuefeng who has been transferred to another post.
